title: Rate Memorandum: Calculating the Prepayment Quote for a School Nutrition Services Meal Account
content:
**The calculation.** The prepayment quote on a School Nutrition Services Meal Account funds the student's reimbursable meals and the items the student buys on their own from the day after the quote date through the end of the calendar month after it, less the account's balance, so a negative balance adds its unpaid meal charges to the quote. The quote counts twenty (20) serving days, a full school month, of one reimbursable lunch at the elementary lunch charge of the student's meal status, with nothing else added.

**The balance.** The account's balance for the quote is its deposits, voids and transfers in less its purchases, refunds, transfers out and returned deposits, as they stand when the quote is made.

**Assembly and rounding.** The quote is put together in this order: first every charge counted for each serving day is added together into the day charge; then the day charge is multiplied by the serving days counted and every amount counted once is added; then the account's balance is subtracted. When that result is zero or less no prepayment is quoted; otherwise the quote is that result, raised to the online deposit minimum when it is below it and lowered to the online deposit maximum when it is above it, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end. With one lunch a day and nothing else, the day charge is the lunch charge and nothing is counted once.

The elementary lunch charge of each meal status is in the cafeteria price schedule; the online deposit minimum and maximum are in the deposit terms.

## Worked quotes (hypothetical accounts)

Taking Paid Meal Status, whose elementary lunch charge is 3.10, the twenty serving days come to 62.00 before the balance:

| Account's balance for the quote | Twenty days less the balance | Quote |
|---|---|---|
| 14.55 | 47.45 | 47.45 |
| 7.20 below zero | 69.20 | 69.20 |
| 58.90 | 3.10 | 10.00 (raised to the online deposit minimum) |
| 70.25 | 8.25 below zero | no prepayment is quoted |
| 250.00 below zero | 312.00 | 300.00 (lowered to the online deposit maximum) |

Taking Reduced-Price Meal Status (elementary lunch charge 0.40) and a balance of exactly zero: twenty days come to 8.00, which is raised to the online deposit minimum of 10.00.
